blocks.text: Curious fans are speculating about the relationship status of Bela Padilla and her ex-boyfriend, tech CEO Martin Tan, after their recent sighting and the apparent removal of the actress’ breakup announcement from her social media pages. Padilla and Tan were seen together in a recent group photo shared by Tekya Martin, a member of the actress’ glam team, through her Instagram Stories. Netizens also pointed out that Padilla appeared to have taken down from her social media pages the breakup announcement she shared in September.
